need: Identify exact available POS hardware and narrow PSP/provider candidates.
probe_or_evidence: Owner photos + Newland official SP830 datasheet + current web evidence for TOSAN TECHNO P3 and Payment Novin/PNA software support.
observed_result: Photo 1 visibly identifies Newland SP830. Photos 2-3 identify TOSAN TECHNO P3, Made in Iran. Public evidence confirms Newland SP830 is manufactured by Fujian Newland Payment Technology; TECHNO P3 is a Tosan Techno POS. Public PNA distribution evidence includes TECHNO P3 software, and PNA is associated with Bank Eghtesad Novin. Exact PSP provisioning of either physical terminal is still not proven from hardware alone.
decision: Record both hardware models as CONFIRMED. Treat TOSAN TECHNO P3 → Payment Novin/Bank Eghtesad Novin as a strong candidate, not yet confirmed for this unit. Do not infer PSP for Newland SP830 from model alone.
reopen_condition: Confirm PSP on each physical unit from receipt, system/about menu, terminal application branding, or support sticker/terminal identifiers; then inspect exact PC-POS/integration interface.
